data_problems: capex: extension element read from the 10-K inline XBRL in FY2020, FY2021, FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 (['ixbrl:ci:PaymentsForProceedsFromPropertyPlantAndEquipment'])
claims_liability: extension element read from the 10-K inline XBRL in FY2025 (['ixbrl:ci:LiabilityForClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseCurrent [sum of segment members]'])
shares_out: values reported in millions in FY2016, FY2017 -> rescaled x1e6
gross_profit: derived as Revenues - CostOfRevenue in 10 of 10 years (no GrossProfit tag)
financial debt uses LongTermDebtAndCapitalLease* tags (may include finance leases; spec excludes leases) in 9 of 10 years
dividends: no XBRL line item in 3 of 10 years -> assumed_zero (FY2016, FY2017, FY2018)
impairments: no XBRL line item in 10 of 10 years -> assumed_zero (FY2016, FY2017, FY2018, FY2019, FY2020, FY2021, FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025)
dividends: tag changes across years -> ['PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock', 'assumed_zero (line item absent while statement retrieved)']
shares jump +52% into FY2019: possible unadjusted split / major event
flags: claims_liability_segment_sum (exhaustive segment members summed; approved convention)
